dialogue.speaker: Obi-Wan Kenobi
dialogue.text: We had a clear defensive perimeter, Anakin. When you charged ahead alone, you left our flank completely exposed to heavy laser fire.

dialogue.speaker: Anakin Skywalker
dialogue.text: If I hadn't charged, their commander would have escaped with the Republic's fleet coordinates. My plan worked, Master.

dialogue.speaker: Obi-Wan Kenobi
dialogue.text: You nearly lost your lightsaber—and your life—acting out of anger and impatience. A Jedi relies on focus, not reckless impulse.

dialogue.speaker: Anakin Skywalker
dialogue.text: I wasn't acting out of anger. I'm simply strong enough in the Force to end battles quickly, even if you refuse to see it.

dialogue.speaker: Obi-Wan Kenobi
dialogue.text: Raw strength without control is a liability, Anakin. Until you learn restraint, you are a danger to yourself and everyone under your command.

dialogue.speaker: Anakin Skywalker
dialogue.text: Fine. Next time I'll wait for your permission while the enemy slips right through our fingers.
